chapter.verse: Pasian’ deihna hangin Khazih Zeisu’ sawltak za-ah hong koih, keimah Paul leh i sanggampa Sosthenes in

Khazih Zeisu hangin mawhna tawh kipelh, misiangtho dinga hong koih ahi Korin khua ah a om Pasian’ pawlpite akipan, mun khempeuh ah eite Topa bek hi lo amau Topa zong ahi, Topa Zeisu Khazih kiangah thu a ngen mi khempeuhte kiangah thu kong zasak uh hi.
Topa Zeisu Khazih leh i Pa Pasian kiang panin hehpihna thupha leh nopna nomau tungah hong tung ta hen.
Khazih’ thu tecipan’na nomau lakah a kip ahih ciangin
note in amah hangah thu genna leh lungpilna a kipan, na khempeuh na kicing uh a,
Khazih Zeisu hangah no hong piak thupha hehpihna suangin, note hangin ka Pasian’ hehpihna ka phat tawntung hi.
Tua ahih ciangin note in i Topa Zeisu Khazih hong kilat ding ngakin na om lai takun hong piakna thupha khat beek na sam kei uh hi.
Tua Topa in eite Topa Zeisu Khazih’ Ni-inah mawhsak nading tawh na kipelh nadingun a tawp dongin no hong kipsak ding hi.
I Topa ahi ama Tapa Zeisu Khazih tawh kipawlna sungah hong sam Pasian in ciam pelh mi ahi kei hi.
Ute naute aw, note khempeuh in kam kikhat na gen uh a, kikhenthang loin, lungsim kikhatin, kiciamtehna kikhatin, kicing takin na om nadingun i Topa Zeisu Khazih’ min tawh kong thuum hi.
Bang hang hiam na cih uh leh, ka ute ka naute aw, note lakah a kitawng om hi ci-in Khlo-e te innkuanpih kimkhat in hong zasak uh hi.
Note in, “Kei Paul’ mi ka hi, kei Apollos’ mi ka hi, kei Kefas’ mi ka hi, kei Khazih’ mi ka hi,” na ci tek uh ka cihna ahi hi.
Khazih a kikhen hiam? Paul in note tang dingin singlamteh tungah a si hiam? Ahih kei leh, Paul’ min tawh kibaptaiz na hi uh hiam?
Krispas leh Gaias longal note lakah kuamah ka baptaiz kei hi ci-in Pasian’ hehpihna ka phat hi.
Tua ahih ciangin, “Paul’ min tawh baptaizna ka ngah hi,” ci-in kuamah in a gen thei kei ding hi.
Stefanas-te innkuan zong ka baptaiz hi. Midangte ka baptaiz lam ka thei kei hi.
Khazih in baptaiz dingin kei hong sawl lo hi; Lungdamna Thu hilh dingin hong sawl hi. Ahih hangin Khazih’ singlamteh a mawkna ahih loh nadingin kam pilna tawh hilh ding hong sawl kei hi.
Bang hang hiam na cih uh leh, siatna a thuakte’ ading singlamteh thu in haina thu ahi hi. Gupna a ngah eite ading tua thu in Pasian’ vangliatna ahi hi.

Bang hang hiam na cih uh leh, Lai Siangtho sungah: “Pilna a neite a pilna ka sugawp ding hi. Lungpil a neite a lungpilna ka sugawp ding hi, Lungpil a neite a lungpilna ka paaimang ding hi,” ci-in a kigelh hi.
Lungpil mi koi-ah a om hiam? Laithei mi koi-ah a om hiam? Hih leitung thu kidong thei mi koi-ah a om hiam? Pasian in leitung pilna a haisak hilo ahi hiam?
Bang hang hiam na cih uh leh, Pasian’ vaihawm bangin leitung mite in amau lungpilna hangah Pasian thei lo uh ahih ciangin, Pasian in a umte thuhilhna hai tawh a gup nading lungsim a nei hi.
Judah mite in nalamdang a ngen thei uh hi. Grik mite in lungpilna a zong thei uh hi.
Eite i hih leh, singlamteh tungah a si Khazih’ thu i hilh hi. Tua thu in Judah mite ading kipukna ahi hi. Gentailte ading haina ahi hi.
Ahih hangin Judah mi hi taleh, Grik mi hi taleh, a kisamte adingin Pasian’ vangliatna leh Pasian’ pilna ahi hi.
Bang hang hiam na cih uh leh, Pasian’ haina in mite’ pilna sangin a pilzaw hi; Pasian’ thanemna in mite’ thahatna sangin a hatzaw hi.
Ute naute aw, note hong sapna thu na ngaihsun un. A hong sap mite lakah leitung pilna a nei mi tampi a om kei uh hi; minthan’na a nei tampi a om kei uh hi; a nam liante tampi a om kei uh hi.
Pasian in lungpilte zumsak nadingin leitung mihaite a teelkhia hi. A thahatte a zumsak nadingin leitungah a thanemte a teelkhia hi.
A omte a man’than sak nadingin leitungah a gina lote leh a kigina sim lote akipan, a om lote nangawn a teelkhia hi.
Tua ahih ciangin Pasian mai-ah kuamah a kisathei ding a om kei hi.
Tua Pasian hangin note in Khazih Zeisu sungah na om uh hi. Tua Khazih Zeisu in eite ading Pasian kiang pan pilna, dikna, sian’thona leh tatkhiatna hong suak zo hi.
Tua ahih ciangin Lai Siangtho sungah a kigelh mah bangin, “A kisatheite in Pasian hangah kisathei ta hen,” a ci hi.
